cohort: The study included 36,827 women who underwent oocyte retrieval (during a clomiphene citrate-based minimal stimulation cycle) followed by their first embryo transfer at a fertility treatment center between January 2008 and December 2017.
finding: Single vitrified-warmed blastocyst transfer (SVBT) was associated with a lower incidence of pregnancy complications, such as hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, low-lying placenta, and placenta previa, and a lower incidence of preterm delivery, low birth weight, and small for gestational age babies compared to single fresh cleavage-stage embryo transfer (SFCT).
